# Supabase JavaScript client 2.119.0

This is an unmodified local copy of the previously deployed pinned UMD library:
<https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0/dist/umd/supabase.min.js>.

The script tag retains the existing R5 SHA-384 integrity value:
`sha384-gnyZit14c5lnGcarmA166QQjjJXpucw25ogZXuwH3HxxY904zHkBqmxVpelsPorb`.

The upstream MIT license is in `LICENSE.supabase-js`. Do not reformat the bundle. Updates require
reviewed version and hash changes plus sign-in/recovery and CSP testing; never replace it with a
floating version. No runtime CDN request is needed.
